coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three prompting methods and all three tasks. The required constants and exact dependent-variable definition are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Does not specify the NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, fixed random seeds, or a shared framework installation and BoT repository configuration. Specifies 5 repeats instead of 10 runs per task. Measures raw wall-clock seconds; a proposed logarithmic plot does not explicitly define the dependent variable as base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion or task-specific logarithmic inference times. The expected-direction discussion in design_output is not a supplied conclusion and also predicts BoT > PAL universally, whereas the ground-truth table has BoT faster than PAL on Game of 24.
